conditions.name: official
conditions.tools: official OpenHands CLI tools; no registered native BrowserToolSet (the image still contains terminal-accessible playwright-cli)

conditions.name: browser_enabled
conditions.tools: official tools plus the complete unmodified native OpenHands BrowserToolSet

conditions.name: guided_vsv
conditions.task_prompt: official plus the frozen detailed function-scoped visual self-verification procedure

sampling.provenance: unchanged OpenHands 1.16.0 / SDK 1.21.0 provider defaults; identical in every condition

worker_network.environment_policy: no-env plus explicit HTTP(S) proxy only
worker_network.browser_proxy_policy: unchanged native OpenHands BrowserToolSet behavior; loopback access is provided by the task container network configuration
worker_network.reason: Level 2/3 generated applications may need npm dependencies before they can deploy

selection.rule: Within each level, sort case IDs by sha256('vision2web-self-verify-v1\0' + case_id) and take the requested count. No workflow or evaluator field is used.

agent_visible: PRD or public prompt.txt when supplied by the benchmark
its own source and browser observations

history.status: archived exploratory evidence used old names, a short cue, and in some runs a custom batch browser interface; never aggregate it with the native-ToolSet experiment-4
